title: Application Launcher (Kickoff) text label is huge on a thick horizontal panel, and not standardized in size with any other panel widgets' labels
line: The Application Launcher's text label in the panel is now about the size of the clock's time instead of filling the whole panel height.
explanation: Kickoff's panel label used VerticalFit with a 32 px maximum inside an item that fills the applet's height, so the text grew until it filled almost the whole panel (about 26 px on a 46 px panel), much larger than the Digital Clock's time, which is sized to 56% of its applet height. Kicker copied the same code in 6.9. The label's font size is now 56% of the applet height, the same rule the clock uses for its time, still capped at the old maximum and still falling back to the default font on very thin panels.

commits.message:
applets/kickoff, kicker: size the panel label like the clock's time

The text label filled the whole height of the applet, so on thick panels
it became much bigger than the Digital Clock and other panel text. Size
it to the same share of the panel height that the clock's time uses.

BUG: 519454

patches.diff:
From f20c6973e1927831d3574d14912b9a14b7fa5c79 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 05:31:57 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/kickoff, kicker: size the panel label like the
 clock's time

The text label filled the whole height of the applet, so on thick panels
it became much bigger than the Digital Clock and other panel text. Size
it to the same share of the panel height that the clock's time uses.

BUG: 519454
---
 applets/kicker/CompactRepresentation.qml | 2 +-
 applets/kickoff/main.qml                 | 2 +-
 2 files changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/kicker/CompactRepresentation.qml b/applets/kicker/CompactRepresentation.qml
index 896b9deafb..e9fbe8cb0d 100644
--- a/applets/kicker/CompactRepresentation.qml
+++ b/applets/kicker/CompactRepresentation.qml
@@ -195,7 +195,7 @@ MouseArea {
             verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
             wrapMode: Text.NoWrap
             fontSizeMode: Text.VerticalFit
-            font.pixelSize: root.tooSmall ? Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont.pixelSize : Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.roundedIconSize(Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 2)
+            font.pixelSize: root.tooSmall ? Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont.pixelSize : Math.min(Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.roundedIconSize(Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 2), Math.round(root.height * 0.56))
             minimumPointSize: Kirigami.Theme.smallFont.pointSize
             visible: root.shouldHaveLabel
         }
diff --git a/applets/kickoff/main.qml b/applets/kickoff/main.qml
index 6b6c95dabe..66d302fb5d 100644
--- a/applets/kickoff/main.qml
+++ b/applets/kickoff/main.qml
@@ -342,7 +342,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
                 verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
                 wrapMode: Text.NoWrap
                 fontSizeMode: Text.VerticalFit
-                font.pixelSize: compactRoot.tooSmall ? Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont.pixelSize : Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.roundedIconSize(Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 2)
+                font.pixelSize: compactRoot.tooSmall ? Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont.pixelSize : Math.min(Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.roundedIconSize(Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 2), Math.round(compactRoot.height * 0.56))
                 minimumPointSize: Kirigami.Theme.smallFont.pointSize
                 visible: compactRoot.shouldHaveLabel
             }
--

media.caption: Default 46 px panel, label 'Applications': the label is far taller than the clock's time
Same panel after the fix: the label is about the size of the clock's time

review.text: Scaling Kickoff's and Kicker's panel label to 56% of applet height matches Digital Clock's time height nicely and resolves the oversized label on thick panels. However, because `tooSmall` is only true when `Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Horizontal`, `Math.round(height * 0.56)` is unbounded below in Planar mode (or during initial creation before geometry settles), which sets `font.pixelSize` to 0 (triggering `QFont::setPixelSize: Pixel size <= 0` warnings and broken initial width) or shrinks below `defaultFont`/`smallFont`.
changes: Clamp the 0.56 * height expression with a lower bound (e.g. `Math.max(Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont.pixelSize, Math.round(compactRoot.height * 0.56))` in `applets/kickoff/main.qml` and similarly with `root.height` in `applets/kicker/CompactRepresentation.qml`) so `font.pixelSize` is never 0 during initialization or smaller than the default font in Planar mode.
Add a brief inline comment explaining the `0.56` factor (matching Digital Clock's two-line time height), consistent with the existing comment on `tooSmall`.

reviews.text: Right direction and repo (Kickoff and Kicker compact labels), and it does shrink the label. But it does not reproduce the clock's rule: DigitalClock sets a helper's *height* to 0.56 * applet height and VerticalFits the font into it, while this patch uses 0.56 * height as the font *pixel size*, so line spacing is not accounted for. In after-1.png the 'A' cap height is about 30 px against 24 px for the clock's time digits (38 px before), so the label is still roughly 25% bigger than the clock, and the 'line' claim ('about the size of the clock's time') overstates it. The title asks for the label to match other panel text, so it should actually match the clock it claims to copy.
changes: Size the label the way DigitalClock sizes its time (box height Math.round(height * 0.56), VerticalFit into it, capped by the theme/default size) so the rendered cap height matches the default two-line clock, and show a before/after crop proving equal text height at 46 px and one other thickness.
Factor the duplicated expression so Kickoff and Kicker stay identical (or at least comment where 0.56 comes from), and update the line/explanation to describe the measured result accurately.
